arabic_html:
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ
وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ ۞
translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
explanation_html: Nothing in you is hidden from Him — Ibn Kathīr notes even the whisper of your soul is known, and His knowledge and angels are nearer to you than your own jugular vein.
